items.body:
The Congo Ebola outbreak has reached 12,021 confirmed cases and 5,904 deaths, the health ministry says, as daily infections fall but contact tracing lags.
Daily new infections fell to 66 confirmed cases on 24 November from 109 a week earlier, the ministry said, but transmission continues in four provinces and almost half of the day’s deaths happened outside treatment centres, a sign that many patients still reach care late.
According to situation report number 194 , published on 25 November, the overall case fatality rate of the Congo Ebola outbreak stands at 49.1%. The figures are cumulative confirmed cases and deaths since the Bundibugyo outbreak was declared on 15 May. The ministry counts 3,232 people who have recovered and 1,092 patients in isolation or treatment centres.

items.body:
The León Zoo in Guanajuato temporarily closed this week after a bird flu outbreak killed a wild cat and a spider monkey.
The zoo in León, Guanajuato, temporarily closed its doors to the public this week amid an avian influenza outbreak that has killed birds and at least two mammals.
Officials believe migratory birds may have introduced the virus to the zoo, located in the northeast of León, Guanajuato’s largest city.
Zoo León announced its decision to close in a statement and a video message posted to social media.

items.title: Ebola Cases In DR Congo Surpass 12,000 As Responders Struggle To Contain Outbreak
items.titleKo: DR콩고의 에볼라 감염자 수가 1만2,000명을 넘어섬에 따라 방역 당국이 확산 방지에 어려움을 겪고 있습니다.
items.body:
The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo has risen above 12,000, as health workers continue to battle the country's second-largest outbreak on record. According to government data released on Thursday, 12,021 infections have been confirmed, while 5,904 people have died. The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, was declared in mid-May in Ituri Province, northeastern Congo. It has since spread to eight of the country's 26 provinces.
There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. Late detection, ongoing conflict and overstretched health services have also caused the virus to spread faster than in previous outbreaks.
The epidemic is now the second-largest and deadliest on record, behind only the 2014–2016 outbreak in West Africa, which infected more than 28,600 people and killed over 11,000.
items.bodyKo:
콩고민주공화국에서 확인된 에볼라 감염자 수가 1만2,000명을 넘어섰으며, 보건의료 종사자들은 콩고 역사상 두 번째로 큰 규모의 에볼라 유행병과 계속 싸우고 있습니다. 목요일에 발표된 정부 자료에 따르면, 12,021명의 감염이 확인되었으며 5,904명이 사망한 것으로 나타났습니다. 에볼라 바이러스의 희귀한 분디부교 변종에 의한 이번 유행은 5월 중순 콩고 북동부의 이투리주에서 선포되었습니다. 이후 이 질병은 콩고의 8개 지역으로 확산되었습니다.
현재 분디부교 바이러스 변이에 대해 승인된 백신이나 치료제가 없습니다. 늦은 발견, 지속되는 분쟁, 과도한 부담을 지고 있는 보건 서비스로 인해 이번 바이러스는 이전 유행보다 더 빠르게 확산되었습니다.
이번 에볼라 유행은 2014~2016년 서아프리카에서 발생한 유행(감염자 28,600명 이상, 사망자 11,000명 이상)에 이어 기록상 두 번째로 규모가 크고 치명적인 유행입니다.

items.body:
An Ebola loperamide study of 5,509 patients from the 2013-16 west African epidemic links the diarrhoea drug to lower death risk, The Lancet Global Health says.
Ebola patients with diarrhoea who were given loperamide during the 2013-16 west African epidemic were less likely to die, according to an Ebola loperamide study of 5,509 patients published on Wednesday in The Lancet Global Health.
The findings matter because loperamide is a cheap, widely available tablet, and most Ebola deaths come early, when patients lose large amounts of fluid. The authors said WHO should reassess the drug for its supportive-care guidance, as the Democratic Republic of the Congo battles the largest Ebola outbreak in its history.

items.title: UK Confirms Bird Flu Outbreak at Herefordshire Poultry Farm
items.titleKo: 영국, 헤리퍼드셔 가금류 농장에서 조류독감 발병 확인
items.body:
H5N1 bird flu has been confirmed at a commercial poultry farm near Leominster, prompting protection zones and the culling of affected birds.
11 Reads Last Update Nov 26, 2026 - 22:25 Share WhatsApp Smallest Font Largest Font A new H5N1 bird flu outbreak at a commercial poultry farm near Leominster in Herefordshire has prompted movement restrictions and disease-control zones, with authorities ordering the humane culling of affected birds to limit the spread of infection. The Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra) confirmed the outbreak on November 26, 2026.
Authorities established a 3km (1.8-mile) protection zone and a 10km (6.2-mile) surveillance zone around the infected premises. The restrictions took effect on Wednesday, November 25, according to the BBC.
Poultry keepers and people responsible for other captive birds within the designated areas must comply with enhanced biosecurity requirements and restrictions on moving birds and related products.

The construction of a U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine facility in Kenya must be halted because the country’s government violated the constitution by not consulting with the public or disclosing its deals with Washington, a court ruled.

The World Health Organization has temporarily withdrawn its Ebola response team from Mongbwalu, the town at the centre of the Democratic Republic of the Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, after fighting closed in around the area. items.body:
Roundup: Renewed DR Congo clashes force civilian flight, Ebola team evacuations-
Renewed fighting in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has forced thousands of civilians to flee their homes and prompted the evacuation of Ebola response personnel, deepening a humanitarian crisis in a region already struggling to contain a deadly epidemic.
KINSHASA, Nov. 26 (Xinhua) -- Renewed fighting in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has forced thousands of civilians to flee their homes and prompted the evacuation of Ebola response personnel, deepening a humanitarian crisis in a region already struggling to contain a deadly epidemic.
Clashes between the Congolese armed forces and the Convention for the Popular Revolution (CRP), a rebel group led by Thomas Lubanga, have intensified since the weekend in Djugu territory of Ituri Province, one of the epicenters of the ongoing Ebola outbreak.

items.body:
More than 5,900 people have died as conflict, delayed detection and overstretched health services hamper efforts to contain DR Congo Ebola outbreak.
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) has surpassed 12,000 confirmed cases, with nearly 5,904 deaths recorded as health responders struggle to contain the disease.
Government data released on Thursday showed that confirmed infections had reached 12,021, making the outbreak the second-largest and deadliest on record.
The epidemic, caused by the rare Bundibugyo species of the Ebola virus, was declared in mid-May in Ituri province in northeastern Congo. It has since spread to eight of the country’s 26 provinces.
There are currently no approved treatments or vaccines for this particular strain of the virus, adding to the challenges facing health authorities.

items.body:
애드페스트(ADFEST)가 2027년 심사위원장 3인을 추가 발표했다. 애니 해버크로프트(Anny Havercroft) 틱톡 글로벌 제품 마케팅 커뮤니케이션 및 업계 교육 총괄, 롭 갈루조(Rob Galluzzo) 핀치(FINCH) 대표 겸 총괄 프로듀서, 야기 요시히로(Yoshihiro Yagi) 덴츠 재팬(dentsu Japan) 총괄 크리에이티브 디렉터(ECD) 및 성장 책임자(Growth Officer)다.26일 애드페스트에 따르면 디자인과 디지털 미디어, 영상 제작 분야에서 풍부한 경험을 쌓은 업계 리더 3명이 합류하면서
애니 해버크로프트·롭 갈루조·야기 요시히로 심사위원장 발탁 디지털·소셜부터 필름 크래프트·디자인까지… 다양한 분야 전문가 7인 확정 30주년 맞은 애드페스트, 2027년 3월 18~20일 태국 파타야서 개최
먼저 애니 해버크로프트(Anny Havercroft) 틱톡 총괄은 디지털 & 소셜 로터스(Digital & Social Lotus), 디지털 크래프트 로터스(Digital Craft Lotus), 게이밍 & 스포츠 로터스(Gaming & Sports Lotus) 심사위원장을 맡았다.
그는 틱톡의 제품 마케팅 커뮤니케이션과 업계 교육을 이끌며 브랜드와 마케터들이 틱톡의 광고 솔루션과 비즈니스 기회를 이해할 수 있도록 지원하고 있다.
틱톡에 합류하기 전에는 영국과 호주에서 활동하며 야후(Yahoo)와 WPP의 고위 임원을 역임했다. SXSW 시드니의 자문위원으로 활동하고 있으며 여성 기업가들을 위한 멘토링도 진행하고 있다.
해버크로프트 총괄은 "아이디어를 구상하는 과정에서 크리에이터가 남긴 흔적을 살펴본다"며 "브리프 자체를 바꾼 오디언스 인사이트, 새로운 콘텐츠 형식에 영감을 준 소비자 행동, 혹은 새로운 방향을 열어준 예상치 못한 제품 활용 방식 등이 그 예"라고 심사 기준을 밝혔다.

items.body:
Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, has secured access to up to 1.5 million doses of an experimental Ebola vaccine following an outbreak
Gavi , the Vaccine Alliance, has secured access to up to 1.5 million doses of an experimental Ebola vaccine following an outbreak that has recorded more than 11,600 cases and 5,700 deaths, mostly in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC).
The alliance announced an advance purchase agreement with India’s Serum Institute of India (SII) and Serum Life Sciences for the supply of ChAdOx1 BDBV, an experimental vaccine developed jointly by the institute and the Oxford Vaccine Group at the University of Oxford.
The agreement is intended to guarantee rapid access to the vaccine if clinical trials establish its effectiveness and it receives regulatory approval and World Health Organisation (WHO) policy recommendations.

백신 연합인 가비(Gavi)는 대부분 콩고민주공화국(DRC)에서 11,600건 이상의 감염 사례와 5,700명의 사망자가 발생한 에볼라 바이러스의 확산에 대응하여 실험용 에볼라 백신 최대 150만 회분을 확보했습니다.
이 연합은 인도 세럼 인스티튜트(SII) 및 세럼 라이프 사이언시스와 ChAdOx1 BDBV를 공급하기 위한 사전 구매 계약을 체결했다고 발표했습니다. ChAdOx1 BDBV는 세럼 인스티튜트와 옥스퍼드 대학교의 옥스퍼드 백신 그룹이 공동으로 개발한 실험용 백신입니다.
이 계약은 임상 시험을 통해 백신의 효능이 입증되고 규제 승인 및 세계보건기구(WHO)의 정책 권고를 받는 경우 신속한 백신 접종을 보장하기 위한 것입니다.

items.title: Fighting in eastern Congo forces Ebola workers to evacuate, threatening outbreak response
items.titleKo: 콩고 동부 지역의 전투로 인해 에볼라 대응 인력이 대피하게 되면서 에볼라 확산 방지 대응에 차질이 생길 위기에 처함 - ABC 뉴스
items.body:
Escalating fighting in eastern Congo has forced health workers to evacuate and blocked roads needed to reach Ebola patients
Share BUNIA, Congo -- Escalating fighting in eastern Congo has forced Ebola response workers to leave affected areas and disrupted efforts to contain the deadliest outbreak in the country , health officials and humanitarian workers said Wednesday.
The fighting between the army and rebel groups has prevented teams from reaching some communities, disrupted monitoring of people exposed to the virus and left some treatment centers with fewer staff, said Dr. Catherine Smallwood, the World Health Organization’s Ebola incident manager.
Congo’s Ebola outbreak has infected more than 11,700 people and killed more than 5,700 since it was declared in May, according to the latest government data. It is the deadliest of Congo’s 17 outbreaks and is on track to surpass the death toll from the West African outbreak that killed 11,000 people between 2014 and 2016.
items.bodyKo:
콩고 동부 지역에서 전투가 격화되면서 보건 의료 인력이 대피해야 했고, 에볼라 환자에게 접근하는 데 필요한 도로가 차단되었습니다.
콩고 부니아 -- 보건 당국 관계자와 인도주의 활동가들이 수요일, 콩고 동부 지역에서 전투가 격화되면서 에볼라 대응 인력이 감염 지역을 떠나야 했고, 이로 인해 콩고에서 발생한 가장 치명적인 에볼라 유행을 억제하기 위한 노력이 차질을 빚고 있다고 밝혔습니다.
세계보건기구(WHO)의 에볼라 사태 관리자인 캐서린 스몰우드(Catherine Smallwood) 박사는 군대와 반군 단체 간의 전투로 인해 팀이 일부 지역사회에 접근하지 못하고, 바이러스에 노출된 사람들에 대한 모니터링이 중단되었으며, 일부 치료 센터의 인력이 부족해졌다고 말했습니다.
최근 정부 자료에 따르면, 콩고의 에볼라 유행은 5월에 공식 선언된 이후 11,700명 이상을 감염시키고 5,700명 이상을 사망에 이르게 했습니다. 이번 사태는 콩고에서 발생한 17번의 에볼라 유행 중 가장 치명적이며, 2014년부터 2016년까지 11,000명의 목숨을 앗아간 서아프리카 에볼라 유행의 사망자 수를 넘어설 것으로 예상됩니다.
